messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — canary group 'canary-2026-03' reporting elevated 5xx and reroutes. Observed sticky fallback to v1-legacy pinned to eu-west-1 causing request pileup and per-tenant throttling. Root TS 3111112223
ava: i'm on it, paging oncall. can someone drop the metric links?
ops-oncall: taking this. can you summarize impact?
ava: canary error rate ~12% over 3m, overall 95p latency in eu-west spiked to 2.1s. quota enforcer returning 429s for some customers (rate-limit + backlog).
marc: which customers reported issues? do we have enterprise impact?
irene-support: ticket #78421 (Acme Corp) reports repeated 429s and timeouts since 10:37 UTC. they see degraded UX on search.
jon-sre: quick triage: canary failing -> fallback kicks in -> fallback implementation is sticky-to-region -> lots of sessions pinned to eu-west variant v1-legacy which is near capacity -> throttles firing. looks like a cascade.
li-runtime: current rollout policy snapshot:
```
smartRouting:
  policy: canary-rollout
  canary_percent: 10
  fallback:
    type: sticky-to-region
    ttl: 10m
```
li-runtime: tl;dr: sticky + region affinity + canary failure = hot spot and throttling.
ava: propose mitigation: 1) pause canary, 2) clear sticky affinity keys for the canary match, 3) scale eu-west pool or revert variant.
ops-oncall: how do we clear sticky affinity? any admin api?
li-runtime: yes — admin API to clear affinity keys for a rollout. example:
```
POST /admin/fallbacks/clear
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "match": "canary-2026-03",
  "scope": "affinity",
  "region": "eu-west-1"
}
```
ops-oncall: running the clear now...
ops-oncall: response 200, cleared 14,312 sticky keys for match=canary-2026-03
jon-sre: also kicking extra capacity in eu-west (+3 GPU nodes). ETA ~4-6m.
deploy-bot: scale task started (task_id=98765)
ava: pausing the canary to stop new traffic hitting the failing variant -> POST /api/rollouts/pause canary-id=canary-2026-03
deploy-bot: canary paused (canary-id=canary-2026-03)
irene-support: Acme reports partial improvement but still seeing some 429s tied to older sessions.
li-runtime: recommendation: change fallback behavior for paused canary to stateless-random and reduce fallback ttl to 30s to avoid prolonged pinning while we stabilize.
marc: what's the risk of switching fallback to stateless-random?
li-runtime: brief increase in cross-region traffic while affinities churn, but avoids long tail of pinned sessions causing throttling. safer than long TTL sticky.
ava: ok, apply change: set fallback.type=stateless-random and fallback.ttl=30s for canary match
ops-oncall: applied. config diff:
```
fallback:
  type: stateless-random
  ttl: 30s
```
jon-sre: monitoring — canary group error rate falling to ~1.4% within 2m, eu-west latency returning to baseline.
ops-oncall: scale-up finished, nodes healthy.
ava: initiating full rollback of canary to stable to be conservative (we'll re-run with a patched variant later).
deploy-bot: rollback started (canary -> stable) task_id=98789
irene-support: customer comms drafted and sent to impacted tenants; support team following up with Acme.
marc: we'll need a postmortem: action items — li-runtime: review default fallback policy and add a safety check to avoid sticky region pin for canaries when utilization>80%; jon-sre: add an autoscale threshold tied to fallback backpressure; deploy-bot: make 'clear affinity' tool visible in runbook; irene-support: compile affected customer list for outreach.
ava: handing off to next oncall @ops-oncall_end — mitigations in place, monitoring.
ops-oncall: ack, taking over. final status: mitigated (config change + scale + rollback). monitoring for regressions. last observed decrease at 3111112380.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated. Severity P2. Postmortem requested by marc.
